license_required.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to profess to be a podiatrist, to practice or assume the duties incident to podiatry without first obtaining from the Mississippi State Board of Medical Licensure a license authorizing the practice of podiatry in this state

issuing_authority.quote: obtaining from the Mississippi State Board of Medical Licensure a license authorizing the practice of podiatry in this state

age_minimum.quote: All applicants for license shall have attained the age of twenty-one (21) years

moral_character_required.quote: shall be of good moral character

degree_required.value: Graduate of a college of podiatry with at least a four-year course of study
degree_required.quote: be graduates of some college of podiatry recognized as being in good standing by the State Board of Medical Licensure. No college of podiatry or chiropody shall be accredited by the board as a college of good standing that does not require for graduation a course of study of at least four (4) years

accrediting_body.value: Council on Education of the American Podiatry Association
accrediting_body.quote: recognized by the Council on Education of the American Podiatry Association

exams.name: State podiatry licensure examination
exams.notes: Subjects include anatomy, histology, physiology, chemistry, pharmacy, materia medica, therapeutics, bacteriology, pathology, surgery, dermatology, neurology, physical therapy, diagnosis and roentgenology, orthopedics, chiropody and chiropodial surgery; minimum 75% average required
exams.quote: be examined in the following subjects: anatomy, histology, physiology, chemistry, pharmacy, materia medica, therapeutics, bacteriology, pathology, surgery, dermatology, neurology, physical therapy, diagnosis and roentgenology, orthopedics, chiropody and chiropodial surgery

exams.name: National Board of Chiropody or Podiatry Licensure examination
exams.notes: Board may affiliate with National Board for granting licenses, provided written examination covers at least two-thirds of required subjects
exams.quote: The State Board of Medical Licensure may affiliate with the National Board of Chiropody or Podiatry Licensure in granting licenses to practice podiatry in Mississippi

interval_years.quote: the license of every person licensed to practice podiatry in the State of Mississippi shall be renewed annually

available.quote: a license without examination may be issued to podiatrists of other states maintaining equal statutory requirements for the practice of podiatry and extending the same reciprocal privileges to this state

requirements.value: Other state must maintain equal statutory requirements and extend same reciprocal privileges to Mississippi; fee not to exceed $500
requirements.quote: Upon payment of a fee prescribed by the State Board of Medical Licensure, not to exceed Five Hundred Dollars ($500.00), a license without examination may be issued to podiatrists of other states maintaining equal statutory requirements for the practice of podiatry and extending the same reciprocal privileges to this state

definition_quote.value: The practice of podiatric medicine is that profession concerned with the prevention, examination, diagnosis and medical, surgical and adjuvant treatment of conditions of the human foot. For the purposes of this chapter, "foot" means that part of the human anatomy which consists of the tarsal bones, metatarsal bones and phalanges.
definition_quote.quote: The practice of podiatric medicine is that profession concerned with the prevention, examination, diagnosis and medical, surgical and adjuvant treatment of conditions of the human foot. For the purposes of this chapter, "foot" means that part of the human anatomy which consists of the tarsal bones, metatarsal bones and phalanges.

methods_authorized.quote: prevention, examination, diagnosis and medical, surgical and adjuvant treatment of conditions of the human foot

drug_authority.value: May prescribe and administer drugs and tests, excluding general and spinal anesthesia, essential to podiatric medicine for treatment of disorders of the human foot
drug_authority.quote: A podiatrist may prescribe and administer drugs and tests, excluding general and spinal anesthesia, that are essential to the practice of podiatric medicine when used for or in connection with treatment of disorders of the human foot.

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: "foot" means that part of the human anatomy which consists of the tarsal bones, metatarsal bones and phalanges

anesthesia_authority.quote: A podiatrist may prescribe and administer drugs and tests, excluding general and spinal anesthesia

impaired_practitioner_program.quote: a portion of which fee shall be used to support a program to aid impaired podiatrists
